remarks: Welcome to Cove View - East Norwalk: Lovely Townhouse style condo/apt with 2 Bedrooms/2 Full Baths, in sought after East Norwalk water community on a walk to the water dead-end street. Open floorplan Living Room w/sliders to private deck to relax and enjoy serene water views - Kitchen w/breakfast bar and plenty of natural light. Bedroom w/skylights, vaulted ceiling & walk-in closet, a full Bath completes the 1st level. Up to the 2nd floor where you will find an updated full Bath and Primary BR complete with skylight and vaulted ceiling. Off street 2 parking spaces in drive, professionally landscaped yard complete this rental. Good credit a must. 2 months security and references required. Apartment will be profesionally cleaned prior to move in and new exterior doors installed. Walk/bike to all E. Norwalk amenities, East & South Norwalk Train Stations, Farm to Table Market, Wine Basket, Restaurants, Ice Cream Shop, Copps Island Oysters, Shorehaven Golf, Shore & Country Club, Dog Park, SoNo restaurants, nightlife, Maritime Museum & Aquarium & SoNo Collection Mall. A Commuter's delight located only 55 miles north of NYC. Minutes to I-95/Merritt Pwy. Available to move-in early to mid-November. Efficient gas heat, new Ductless AC Units. Come and enjoy the lifestyle of living in 06855.
